thread:
emma: FYI we've published an update to the Bereavement & Personal Leave section of the handbook. Also launching a required 10-minute attestation + micro-training for all managers and full-time staff. Link: https://handbook.redwood.company/bereavement-personal-leave 

emma: The attestation asks managers to confirm they've reviewed team leave coverage plans for high-impact roles. Training covers policy scope, local law differences, and reasonable accommodation basics. :white_check_mark:

raj: Quick q: how does this interact with local statutory bereavement rules (UK/EU)? Any region-specific text?

emma: Good call. The handbook page now has regional notes per country. Where statutory leave exceeds our policy, local law applies (we added language clarifying that).

lydia: Will people need to sign an attestation form, or is completion tracked automatically in the LMS?

emma: LMS will auto-record completion. Managers will also need to tick a short attestation checkbox visible in the tracker UI. We'll surface that as a boolean in the CSV export.

tom: Contractors question: do we include long-term contractors on SOWs?

emma: Long-term contractors with company accounts get the training; short-term temps without accounts don't. If you think a contractor should be included, @people-ops and we'll provision a training-only account for up to 14 days.

sara: Any opt-out for folks who covered a similar course last month?

emma: If you completed equivalent training in the last 60 days, email people-ops@redwood.com with a copy and we'll mark you exempt. Use subject: "Bereavement Training Exemption - [name]".

hr-bot: Automated assignment: 212 employees assigned to "Bereavement & Personal Leave 10min attestation". Due: 2025-10-01. Tracker: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (snapshot 2025-09-08 09:12 UTC) :bell:

lydia: For the managers CSV can we get these columns: `employee_email, manager_email, location, attestation_completed_at, attestation_by_manager`? saves me a join.

emma: Yes 10-column export will include those. Example snippet in the export: ```employee_email,manager_email,location,attestation_completed_at,attestation_by_manager,exemption_note```

raj: Missed deadline policy? escalation?

emma: Reminder emails at 7 days, 3 days, and 24 hours. Missed > 10 days = manager notify and a soft flag in HR dashboard. No immediate disciplinary action; case-by-case for repeated misses.

tom: Can we add an accommodations contact? some folks will need extra time.

emma: Added accommodations contact on the handbook page (people-ops-accomms@redwood.com). Managers can request extensions via that inbox.

sara: Thanks 11 will add a blurb to the People Managers digest.

emma: Thanks team. I'll drop the CSV to #managers on Monday and follow up with a short changelog note. :sparkles:
